sql: select split_part(event_ticker,'-',2) as contest, count(distinct (close_time at time zone 'UTC')::date) as utc_dates, count(*) as markets, min(close_time) as first_close, max(close_time) as last_close from mmsell_settlement_meta where event_ticker like 'KXMLB%' and close_time > now() - interval '10 days' group by 1 having count(distinct (close_time at time zone 'UTC')::date) > 1 order by 3 desc limit 20
